item.title: StarRocks: FE query planning and the MPP path
item.description: StarRocks is a MySQL-compatible MPP OLAP engine. A cluster is Frontend (FE) nodes for metadata and query coordination plus Backend (BE) or Compute Node (CN) workers for execution. This post follows FE query planning—logical plan, Cascades optimize, fragmentize—and the MPP path through schedule, deploy, and result pull. Worker process internals are in Backend and Compute Node.
